name: scenario-to-cloud.cloud-real-vps-qualification
purpose: Qualify matrix cases on an approved disposable real VPS through governed scenario-to-cloud operations; refuse absent authority or non-staging targets and leave cells pending until independent assertions exist.

request_id.description: Idempotent qualification request id, e.g. cl2-fixture-run-001-real_vps.

release_ref.description: Immutable release manifest digest sha256:<64 hex>; a mutable reference is refused as stale_artifact.

target_ref.description: Bridge machine identity disposable-vps:<id>; the resolved deployment must use this machine id, Bridge transport and a nonempty node id.

environment_ref.description: Isolated staging environment id prefixed cl2-staging:; production and general environments are refused.

workload_ref.description: Declaration-derived fixture id from fixtures/workloads or fixtures/coexistence.

authorization_ref.description: Operator grant reference designating target_ref as the approved disposable VPS and permitting only the requested deployment operation; absent means refused.

lane.description: Certification lane selected from the matrix; cases must be required in this lane and applicable to the real_vps ground.

target_ground.description: This runner is real-VPS-ground only. QEMU evidence requires the separate QEMU runner.

cases.description: Exactly one matrix case id per target operation; it must be required for the selected lane and explicitly applicable to target_ground=real_vps. Batches require case-specific fixture and assertion drivers.

faults.description: faults.allowed lists lane fault capabilities (worker_restart, lease_expiry, lost_reply, transport_disconnect, target_reboot, data_interruption).

deployment_id.description: Optional exact deployment id on the owned guest; empty resolves by (workload_ref as scenario_id, environment_ref).

target_generation.description: Expected positive Bridge enrollmentGeneration, observed from the enrolled disposable VPS target. The resolved deployment target must match it exactly.

assumptions: scenario-to-cloud is running and the declared deployment, operation and target-owner receipt bindings are governed

An operator has already provisioned, snapshotted and Bridge-enrolled the disposable VPS after A2 approval, and supplied its machine identity and positive enrollment generation; this program never creates, installs, downloads or destroys infrastructure
The session holds the destructive grant for deployment/apply; without it the act phase is refused and nothing is mutated
Before apply, the resolved deployment target must use Bridge transport, the expected machine id, a nonempty node id and the exact positive enrollment generation supplied for this run
Fault injection and per-case assertion execution remain separate owner workflows; a successful deploy/health journey leaves all cells pending_assertions
No additional spend is authorized by this runner (spend_ceiling_minor_units must be zero)
invariants: admission refuses missing authorization, non-staging environment, incompatible target, stale candidate, unknown fault capability, non-zero spend ceiling, and any case outside the selected lane before reads or writes
The only mutation is one deployment/apply of the compiled plan digest with request_id as idempotency key; same-key replay does not create another intent
A deployment whose target machine_id differs from target_ref, or whose environment differs from environment_ref, is never applied
No shell string, credential, host install, image download, target create, DNS change or production deployment is issued by this program
Every effect goes through a declared scenario-to-cloud binding
A non-terminal operation after one bounded wait is reported with its id and never converted into failure
No cell is marked passed and no certification receipt is written by this program; per-case assertions and target-owner evidence remain required
One envelope is printed on every path
Un-enrolled SSH, missing node identity, zero/absent generation, or a generation mismatch is refused before plan/apply; the operator-supplied generation must exactly match the resolved Bridge target
Every admitted cell includes its canonical case/lane/ground assertion driver; deployment, health, and target-owner receipts alone never satisfy the assertion.

bindings.note: Used when deployment_id is empty: selector (scenario_id=workload_ref, environment=environment_ref).
Requires the session grant and _confirm; refused otherwise.
Fresh Bridge target-owner receipt read scoped to deployment, operation, admitted step, plan digest and enrollment identity; never writes certification evidence.
An unreachable observation leaves health unknown; the journey is then unverified, not failed.

signals.standing: refused, admitted, ready_to_act, no_op, applied_without_operation, operation_pending, journey_failed, journey_unverified or deploy_health_verified_pending_assertions
signals.cells: [{case_id, lane, target_ground, verdict, operation_ref?, target_receipt_refs[], assertion_driver:{driver_ref, owner, trigger, expected_assertion, status}}]; target receipt refs bind the operation and step and carry a positive fence; owner assertion remains pending until its case-specific receipt and hashed assertion artifact arrive.
signals.target: target_ref, target_ground, operator-supplied target_generation, resolved Bridge machine_id/node_id/enrollment_generation, environment_ref and bound deployment_id
signals.deployment: resolved deployment id, scenario, environment, machine_id, transport
signals.plan: plan_digest, release_digest and closure_status of the compiled plan
signals.operation: operation_id, state, terminal, fence, and target-owner receipt standing for the deploy effect when the owner receipt API is available
signals.health: status, freshness, observed_release_digest from the health observation
signals.edge: route and private listener counts from the edge observation
signals.validation_run: unavailable when the latest test-genie run could not be read
signals.fault_injection: present when faults were requested: names the missing governed binding
signals.faults_allowed: fault capabilities admitted for this run
signals.next_action: the owner action required next, including reading/reconciling a missing or failed target receipt

outputs.evidence: authorization reference, matrix revision, Bridge machine/node identity and enrollment generation, latest test-genie run id, operation id; receipts are pending until independent per-case assertions and target-owned evidence exist

budget.async_reason: deployment/apply plus one bounded operation wait exceeds the 120 s synchronous bound

fixtures.note: Admission refuses before any binding is called; this fixture needs no external target or operator action.
Admission refuses non-staging environments before reads or writes.
Admission refuses a missing expected enrollment generation before any binding is called.
